decisive_items: basophilic cells and shadow cells in the deep dermis
chalky-white cut surface and lobulated appearance
response.rationale: Basophilic cells with shadow cells are pathognomonic for pilomatrixoma, supported by the chalky-white lobulated cut surface and hard nodule. The other candidates lack these definitive histologic findings.

rejected.why: Red color and dilated lymphatic vessels are nonspecific and do not explain basophilic/shadow cells.
Multilocular spaces and dilated lymphatics may be secondary changes; no basophilic/shadow cells are described.
Firm nodule is nonspecific and lacks the characteristic histologic features of pilomatrixoma.
